title: Pierogi Quesadilla
description: A Mexican twist on classic Polish pierogi, filled with cheese and wrapped in a tortilla.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the melted butter and swirl to coat.
Place a tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle shredded cheese on half of it.
Add 2-3 pierogi on top of the cheese.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the filling.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve with sour cream and chopped cilantro if desired.
Serve with sauerkraut on the side as a topping.
